title: Shared normalization predicates for completion and scalar extension
statement: For a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, an embedding $\iota:E\to L$, and a scheme $W$, use the completed coefficient sheaves and principal uniformizer quotient models [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, lem-a1-principal-koszul-strict-replacement, def-pur-principal-quotient-completion-model]. Define three predicates, with independent site and coefficient universes. QuotientRealization expresses the whole-unit equality with the actual reduction-limit adjunction and a strict quotient-tower comparison preserving augmentation and the K-flat counit [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus, lem-trf-completion-unit-strict-quotient-model]. SameIndexFormula records the balanced quotient map, its canonical product comparison, both signed Roos coordinates, and its localized counit square [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings, lem-weil-strict-roos-comparison]. MultiplicationFormula records the quotient tensor multiplication formula, both cone coordinates and the counit square with the specified scalar extension [lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-well-defined, lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. These are exactly the existing point predicates with $\operatorname{Spec}(\overline{\mathbf F}_q)$ replaced by $W$; the point predicates are their specializations. No existence or mathematical property is asserted by this definition.
